A report of an observation of an anomalous phenomenon was entered.
filmed from the cockpit of a national aircraft in flight

Summary: An international (LA582) witness reported filming their craft near the Nicaragua-Honduras border at 38,000 feet.

They stated the object was flying slowly to the SE at approximately 60,000 feet. It was described as round, white, and about the size of two B787s, leading the witness to rule out the possibility of it being an airplane or weather balloon.

The pilot and crew's names and licenses were verified.

It was determined that the LA 582 flight on Saturday, January 19, 2019, was operated by
the Boeing 787-9 with registration CC-BGM, serial number 38771.

To compare the object's size as indicated in the case report, the general dimensions of the B787-9 were checked: length of 62.81 meters and wingspan of 60.12 meters.

From IFIS, the official Flight Plan of LA 582 for January 19, 2019 was recovered, allowing the official flight itinerary and the route from SCEL to Cancun International Airport (OACI code = MMUN) to be known.

The flight tracking record between SCEL and MMUN was investigated, revealing 621 locations with geographic coordinate indications.
